description: Source code for managing channel users in Mattermost CLI, including commands for adding and removing users from channels.

classes.name: cobra.Command
classes.description: Defines CLI commands for managing channel users.

methods.name: channelUsersAddCmdF

methods.name: addUserToChannel

methods.name: channelUsersRemoveCmdF

methods.name: removeAllUsersFromChannel
